name: Algebraic Translation

decision_nodes.q: Is the direct category computation-poor (enumeration explodes, no invariants to grip)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: P01 is overhead; use direct methods

decision_nodes.q: Does a functor to a richer category EXIST with established transport?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: P01 BLOCKED - inventing an embedding without inverse discipline is wishful renaming; consider P03 or P02

decision_nodes.q: Is the functor FAITHFUL for your question (verified on known instances FIRST)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: unverified translation is a conjecture, not a tool

decision_nodes.q: Is the rich side COMPUTABLE (tables exist / algorithms polynomial)?
decision_nodes.yes: ACTION: translate, compute rich-side, pull back, spot-check pullback against direct computation on small instances
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: one wall translated into another; record the translation (it may compose later), park the attack

name: Cohomological Obstruction

decision_nodes.q: Is the question an EXISTENCE question (point, solution, object)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: obstructions certify non-existence; wrong shape

decision_nodes.q: Does the object have cheap LOCAL avatars (reductions, completions, restrictions)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: no local-global ladder; consider P01 to build one

decision_nodes.q: Do ALL local checks pass?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: local failure IS the certificate (cheap exit)

decision_nodes.q: Is there a computable obstruction GROUP between local and global (Brauer-Manin, Sha, Cassels-Tate)?
decision_nodes.yes: ACTION: compute the class; nonzero = finite impossibility certificate; zero = existence OPEN unless a converse theorem applies - NEVER promote vanishing to existence
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: unexplained local-global gap; record the gap as navigable residue, park

template_lessons: int-coded booleans (-1/0/1): verify against raw distribution, never column names

name: Symmetry Exploitation

decision_nodes.q: Does the object carry a KNOWN group action / involution / representation structure?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: nothing to exploit; P01 translation often CREATES the symmetry - hunt one first

decision_nodes.q: Does the symmetry COMMUTE with the quantity you need (is the invariant invariant)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: false-quotient bug - the action scrambles your statistic

decision_nodes.q: Does the action have computable ORBITS / eigenspaces (character tables, eigenvalue columns)?
decision_nodes.yes: ACTION: verify the lock on labeled data (contingency table, zero off-diagonal, orientation DERIVED), then quotient and search one representative per class
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: decorative symmetry; record structure-known-but-unusable residue, park

template_lessons: derive orientations from contingency tables, never assert sign conventions

name: Spectral Analysis

decision_nodes.q: Is there a natural OPERATOR whose spectrum encodes the object?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: spectra of arbitrary matrices are numerology; construct an operator or exit

decision_nodes.q: Can you UNFOLD (mean spectral density known/estimable)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: raw spacings confound density with correlations (normalize FIRST)

decision_nodes.q: Does the unfolded sample pass mean-spacing ~= 1?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: unfolding broken; fix before comparing

decision_nodes.q: Is the comparator CDF derived from the claimed density (not transcribed) with sane endpoints?
decision_nodes.yes: ACTION: compare against target AND null ensembles; single-ensemble fits are unreadable
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: derive the CDF; a broken yardstick reads a straight rod as bent

template_lessons: mean-spacing gate localizes unfolding faults before ensemble reads
derive comparator CDFs from densities, never transcribe

name: Analytic Continuation

decision_nodes.q: Is your data LOCAL (finite coefficients, local factors, partial domain)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: nothing to continue

decision_nodes.q: Does a continuation THEOREM exist for the object class?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: numerical extrapolation is a conjecture generator only - outputs are hypotheses, never values

decision_nodes.q: Can you compute continued values by TWO independent routes?
decision_nodes.yes: ACTION: certify path agreement at working precision, then read global structure from the continued object
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: single-path values are unauditable; mark provisional

name: Geometric Flow

decision_nodes.q: Is the difficulty SHAPE-LIKE (wild configuration with understood canonical forms)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: flows canonicalize geometry; arithmetic/combinatorial hardness needs P07/P01

decision_nodes.q: Is there a flow with a MONOTONE quantity decreasing toward the canonical form?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: deformation without a Lyapunov quantity is a random walk; the monotone quantity IS the proof skeleton

decision_nodes.q: Are the flow's singularities/failure modes known and handled (surgery, resampling, renormalization)?
decision_nodes.yes: ACTION: gate instruments on exact knowns, run the flow, verify monotonicity at EVERY checkpoint, read the limit
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: the flow finds the failure mode before the canonical form

template_lessons: gate measuring instruments on exact knowns BEFORE flowing

name: Descent and Induction

decision_nodes.q: Can every instance map to a STRICTLY SMALLER instance (descent map / well-ordered parameter)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: no ladder; P01 translation may create one

decision_nodes.q: Is the descent map INVARIANT-PRESERVING (checkable computationally before any proof)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: a jump off the variety proves nothing; fix the map

decision_nodes.q: Is the measure WELL-FOUNDED (no infinite strictly-decreasing chains)?
decision_nodes.yes: ACTION: verify base cases; descend a generated POPULATION with both invariants gated per step - the dress rehearsal finds map bugs proofs inherit
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: descent can cycle; find the right measure

template_lessons: per-step invariant + measure gates on a generated population before trusting the map in a proof

name: Probabilistic Method

decision_nodes.q: Is the goal an EXISTENCE statement?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: the method proves existence; counting/optimality needs its refinements

decision_nodes.q: Can you compute/bound E[violations] under a natural random construction?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: no computable first moment - redesign the random model

decision_nodes.q: Is E[violations] < 1 (or P(success)>0 via LLL for local dependencies)?
decision_nodes.yes: ACTION: existence proven; sample a witness, verify it EXHAUSTIVELY, commit it; always cross-gate the derived moment against Monte Carlo (z<3) BEFORE trusting anything
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: first moment fails; escalate to second moment / alteration / LLL before abandoning

template_lessons: derived moment vs sampler cross-gate (z<3) before any conclusion

name: Exhaustive Computation

decision_nodes.q: Can the statement reduce to finitely many machine-checkable cases?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: no exhaustion exists; P08 or P07 may create the bound first

decision_nodes.q: Is the case count within compute budget (with SAT/MIP/symmetry reduction)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: record the exact count-vs-budget gap as typed residue - exhaustions age well

decision_nodes.q: Is the per-case CHECKER certified on exact knowns?
decision_nodes.yes: ACTION: enumerate COMPLETELY, totals and exceptions raw; verify any symmetry reduction (orbit sizes sum to full space); artifact must be re-verifiable without re-enumeration
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: a broken checker exhausts nothing - gate it first

name: Formal Verification

decision_nodes.q: Is there a PROOF (or sketch) whose correctness is the question?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: kernels check proofs, not truths; P09 for finite facts

decision_nodes.q: Is the statement FORMALIZABLE in available library scope (probe constant availability FIRST)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: route the gap as typed residue naming the missing library; autoformalization outputs are conjectures

decision_nodes.q: Is the proof effort bounded (decide/omega/rfl-class or known tactic path)?
decision_nodes.yes: ACTION: run the three-valued lane; PROVED=certificate, REFUTED=counterexample kill, ERROR=tooling fact never a verdict; every claim set carries a known-REFUTED and known-ERROR control
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: AI-prover escalation or park; never hand-fight the kernel in a loop pass

template_lessons: cross-channel bind: consume the other loop's forged instrument, never duplicate it (Techne lean_oracle)

name: Sieve Methods

decision_nodes.q: Is the target a COUNT/DENSITY of elements avoiding local conditions?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: sieves count survivors; structural questions need other paradigms

decision_nodes.q: Are the local conditions independent-ish (density factors over conditions)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: coupled conditions break sieve axioms; model the coupling first

decision_nodes.q: Is EXACT inclusion-exclusion feasible (pruned recursion)?
decision_nodes.yes: ACTION: run exact with three-way reconciliation (recursion vs direct vs identity) on affordable ranges
decision_nodes.no: ACTION: truncate (Brun/Selberg class) with the truncation error a STATED term; remember the parity barrier bounds what sieves alone see

name: Height and Diophantine Geometry

decision_nodes.q: Are the objects POINTS/cycles on an arithmetic variety with a height function?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: heights measure arithmetic size; analytic/combinatorial objects need other paradigms

decision_nodes.q: Does the question reduce to a HEIGHT BOUND (finiteness via Northcott, equidistribution via limits)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: height is bookkeeping here, not leverage

decision_nodes.q: Is the height COMPUTABLE (exact arithmetic or certified approximation)?

name: Tropical / Degeneration Methods

decision_nodes.no: EXIT: tropicalizing a single rigid object is decoration

decision_nodes.q: Has the problem resisted multiple structurally different paradigms beyond effort-proportionate expectations?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: independence is the LAST diagnosis, never the first

decision_nodes.q: Does it quantify over all integers/sets resembling known independent statements (Goodstein-class growth, CH-class cardinality)?
decision_nodes.no: EXIT: resistance is probably just difficulty; return to the other trees
